The basic requirements discussed in section E. were endorsed by TSG RAN in RP-202867 [7] but further clarification/guidance is provided here. E.1 It is mandatory to fill out the "other specs affected" for all CRs, i.e. either Yes or No shall be ticked and if Yes is ticked at least the TS/TR shall be indicated and this for the present WG and all other WGs that have CRs linked to the present CR.

The TP for 38.213 (clause 14) in x2407 is endorsed. Final CRs are agreed in R1-2202819 (TS38.213, Rel-16, CR#0284, Cat. D) and R1-2202820 (TS38.213, Rel-17, CR#0285, Cat. A). MCC post meeting: Revision number needs to be corrected in x2819 prior to submission to RAN. For the 38.213 editor Clause 11.1 in TS38.213 has the same issue as identified in R1-2202407. It is recommended that TS38.213 be revised to improve specification clarity. Please consider the revision in the next specification revision.

Final CRs are agreed in R1-2205388 (TS38.213, Rel-16, CR#0311, Cat. F) and R1-2205389 (TS38.213, Rel-17, CR#0312, Cat. A)

[4] (ran1_cr_chunks 38.214, sim=0.6328)
[CR CR0601 for 38.214] Reason for change: TS38.214 describes Rel-18 Type-II CJT CBSR based on an agreement in RAN1#112bis-e (that a UE must be configured with at least 1 CBSR), which was later superseded by RAN2 decision allowing no CBSR configuration (since N1,N2 configuration is taken out from CBSR IE in TS 38.331 V18.2.0). The change is needed to align the description of TS38.214 with TS 38.331 V18.2.0. Summary of change: Updating the description in TS 38.214 following CBSR configuration structure in TS 38.331. Consequences if not approved: Misaligned configuration/description in TS 38.214 and TS 38.331.
